summary: Records a sent packet and returns its TWCC sequence number.
summary_step: 1. Locks the tracker and initializes the base send time when this is the first packet.
2. Writes packet metadata into the sequence-number ring buffer using a send time relative to the base.
3. Advances the extended sequence number and clears stale last-received state if the ring entry wrapped over it.
4. Updates the active probe cluster max sequence number when the packet belongs to that cluster.
5. Returns the low 16 bits of the assigned sequence number for TWCC transport use.

summary: Applies a TWCC feedback indication to a stored packet record and returns packet metadata plus send and receive deltas.
summary_step: 1. Looks up the packet by sequence number and returns zero values when it is no longer in the ring buffer.
2. Treats a zero receive time as a loss indication while preserving the stored packet metadata.
3. Initializes the remote receive-time base and last received packet on the first received packet.
4. Stores the relative receive time and calculates deltas from the previous received packet.
5. Updates the last received packet pointer and returns the packet copy with computed deltas.
